parole.testo: From Old Church Slavonic мигдалъ (migdalŭ) possibly through Polish migdał, from Latin amygdalus, from Greek ἀμύγδαλος (amýgdalos), ἀμυγδάλη (amygdáli), ἀμυγδάλιον (amygdálion), of Semitic origin. Cognate with Belarusian мігда́л (mihdál), German Mandel, Romanian migdal, Ukrainian мигда́ль (myhdálʹ).
